sloka: यदि मामिह जानीयाद्वर्तमानां स राघवः ।अद्य बाणैरभिक्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसं ।। ५.२४.२१।।।।
transliteration: yadi māmiha jānīyādvartamānāṁ sa rāghavaḥ ।adya bāṇairabhikruddhaḥ kuryāllokamarākṣasaṁ ।। 5.24.21।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita you have shown your love for your husband to this extent. It is enough. O auspicious lady anything carried to excess leads to adversity.
